title.narrative: Financial support to the missions of the African Union in Somalia AMISOM XXIII and ATMIS 1

description.narrative: The action provides financial support from the African Peace Facility (APF) to the missions of African Union in Somalia AMISOM and ATMIS for the year 2022. The support, limited to the police and civilian components of the missions, contributes to the gradual hand-over of security responsibility to the Somali authorities, in line with resolutions of the United Nations Security Council.
